pagerbot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT triggered in #incidents — gpu-pool-7 runtime containers entering CrashLoopBackOff on 5 nodes (node-03,node-07,node-11,node-12,node-14). Root: segfault in runtime fused kernel during inference. Pager: sev2.
oncall_tobi: I'm on it. taking initial triage. any customer-impact signals?
support_ana: seeing elevated 502/500 for hosted API + Dedicated customers in us-west-2 since ~4632099400. Error rate ~4.2% over 15m for model-route /v1/generate (customers using identity: redwood-beta).
eng_maya: logs from pod runtime-serve-abcde: 
```
[2026-03-17T08:10:12Z] F runtime: fused_attn_cuda.cu:segfault at addr 0x0
[2026-03-17T08:10:12Z] E runtime: cudaCheck failed: illegal memory access (700) in fused_attn_forward
[2026-03-17T08:10:12Z] I runtime: model=redwood-open-1q seq_len=6144 batch=1 quant=nf4
stack: backtrace0 -> fused_attn_cuda.cu:line 412 -> runtime_main.cpp:line 223
```
eng_raj: unrolled trace shows Illegal memory access in fused kernel — likely out-of-bounds K/V index for kv-cache with seq_len > 4096. This model variant increased context default.
sre_jamie: nodes are flapping — kubelet restarted containers repeatedly and kube-proxy reported connection churn. I've cordoned node-03 and node-07 to stop scheduling new pods: `kubectl cordon node-03 node-07`
prod_ops_lucas: starting emergency mitigation: rolling back runtime image to v2.18.2 for pods on gpu-pool-7 and setting env REDWOOD_SAFE_FALLBACK=true on the deployment to force non-fused codepath. Will patch via kustomize overlay.
eng_maya: quick commands i ran for a victim pod: 
```
kubectl logs runtime-serve-abcde -n runtime --previous | tail -n 60
kubectl exec -n runtime runtime-serve-abcde -- cat /proc/1/environ | tr '\0' '\n' | grep RUNTIME_TAG
# snapshot of cuda meminfo
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total --format=csv
```
oncall_tobi: do we need to drain any nodes? jamie?
sre_jamie: draining node-11 (one of the flapping hosts) now to stop user traffic and allow manual debugging: `kubectl drain node-11 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`
support_ana: impact update — a small subset of dedicated customers (3 tenants) are seeing timeouts; GameStream Inc reported degraded latency and 2% request errors on their SLA. Notified CS.
eng_raj: mitigation notes: 1) rollback runtime image (v2.18.3 -> v2.18.2) 2) set REDWOOD_BATCH_LIMIT=1 for pool to avoid large-per-step memory spikes 3) disable fused-kernel via REDWOOD_ENABLE_FUSED=0 or use safe fallback 4) redeploy canary to 2 pods and monitor.
prod_ops_lucas: rolling image rollback and env patch now (kustomize apply). Canary pods up (2/2) with v2.18.2 and REDWOOD_ENABLE_FUSED=0 — no segfaults in last 3 min.
eng_maya: verified stack traces on new canary: kernel paths switched to generic CUDA kernels, logs show no illegal memory access.
oncall_tobi: will keep pager open until all nodes stabilized and customer impact resolved. tagging next-oncall for handoff in 15m: @sre_zoe.
sre_jamie: nodes: node-03,node-07 uncordoned once their pods replaced; node-11 remains drained for debug.
support_ana: customer status: GameStream Inc notified; they accepted workaround and will route traffic to a different region for now. CS ticket #INC-2319 created.
eng_raj: root cause hypothesis: fused attention kernel doesn't handle kv-cache layout for certain quantized checkpoint + seq_len > 4096 — triggers OOB access. Repro steps with a local reproduce harness using seq_len=6144 + nf4 quant.
eng_maya: snippet from repro harness: 
```
# repro script (simplified)
python repro.py --model redwood-open-1q --seq_len 6144 --quant nf4 --use-fused
# crash: SIGSEGV in fused_attn_cuda.cu
```
prod_ops_lucas: post-mitigation checks: error rate down to 0.6% in last 10m, crashloops stopped on nodes that received patched pods. rolling back all pools in us-west-2 now.
oncall_tobi: handoff summary for @sre_zoe: sev2 incident; cause = suspected OOB in fused attention kernel with long context + quantized model; mitigation = rollback runtime image to v2.18.2 + disable fused kernels via REDWOOD_ENABLE_FUSED=0 + reduce batch/seq limits; nodes drained and one node remains offline for debugging; customer impact limited to small set of tenants with dedicated capacity. links: CS#INC-2319, PR#4876 (hotfix branch), runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-segfaults
sre_jamie: leaving notes for postmortem: collect coredumps from node-11 (/var/crash/), nvcrash logs, and artifact of runtime build v2.18.3.
eng_maya: next actions: create a failing unit test for kv-cache bounds, add guard in fused kernel, and schedule hotfix release v2.18.4. assigning to eng-runtime.
prod_ops_lucas: will monitor for 1h then close.
support_ana: marking affected customers and follow-up comms in progress.
oncall_tobi: thanks all, handing to @sre_zoe in 10m — include all links and logs above. :white_check_mark: :eyes:
